title: Bitwarden Dual License Model
why_read: Licensing changes at a popular open-source password manager affect how engineers and companies can use and fork the software.
analysis: Bitwarden moving to or clarifying a dual-license model is relevant to anyone who self-hosts, forks, or builds on top of open-source security software. Dual licensing (often open-source plus a commercial license) changes incentives for contributors and downstream users, and often triggers debate about whether a project is still meaningfully 'open'. The large comment count suggests this touched a nerve around open-source sustainability and trust in widely used infrastructure.
